content.heading: A Leading EPC Company in Bangladesh
paragraphs: B-Trac Engineering Ltd. (BTEL), a concern of Bangla Trac Group, is a leading EPC company driving Bangladesh's industrial growth since 2009. We deliver turnkey engineering solutions spanning Substation & Switchgear, Renewable Energy-Solar, MEP-EPC, NALCO Water Treatment Chemicals, and nationwide After Sales Support & Service.

Our success is built on three unwavering commitments: Customer Focus, Quality Excellence, and Timely Delivery. As an ISO 9001:2015 certified organization, BTEL continues to strengthen Bangladesh's industrial landscape through innovation, engineering excellence, and customer trust.

content.heading: 16 Years of Engineering Growth
content.paragraph: From a single-division startup to a multi-division EPC powerhouse — here's how BTEL grew.

milestones.title: Bangla Trac Group Founded
milestones.description: Parent conglomerate Bangla Trac Group established, laying the foundation for BTEL's future engineering operations.

milestones.title: B-Trac Engineering Ltd. Incorporated
milestones.description: B-Trac Engineering Ltd. incorporated and began workshop operations, taking on first projects in substation supply and electrical contracting across Dhaka.

milestones.title: Factory Expansion in Bhulta, Narayanganj
milestones.description: Expanded the workshop into a dedicated factory in Bhulta, Narayanganj, growing manufacturing capacity for all engineering divisions.

milestones.title: ISO 9001:2015 Certification
milestones.description: Achieved ISO 9001:2015 certification, cementing BTEL's commitment to international quality management standards.

milestones.title: Became one of the largest MEP Solution provider for BATB with a project valued at BDT 185 Cr.
milestones.description: Delivered the largest single project in BTEL history — British American Tobacco Bangladesh Savar Factory MEP, at BDT 185 Cr.

content.heading: Let's Engineer Your Next Project From Design to Commissioning
content.paragraph: Five engineering divisions under one roof — substation & switchgear, solar power, MEP/EPC, water treatment, and lifetime after-sales support. Since 2009, BTEL has delivered BDT 500 Cr+ in projects for 60+ of Bangladesh's most demanding industrial clients, with design, procurement, installation, and commissioning handled entirely in-house.
